1: //! Analysis rules to perform basic type inference on individual expressions.
2: 
3: use rustc_hash::FxHashSet;
4: 
5: use ruff_python_ast as ast;
6: use ruff_python_ast::{Expr, Operator, UnaryOp};
7: 
8: #[derive(Debug, Clone, PartialEq, Eq)]
9: pub enum ResolvedPythonType {
10:     /// The expression resolved to a single known type, like `str` or `int`.
11:     Atom(PythonType),
12:     /// The expression resolved to a union of known types, like `str | int`.
13:     Union(FxHashSet<PythonType>),
14:     /// The expression resolved to an unknown type, like a variable or function call.
15:     Unknown,
16:     /// The expression resolved to a `TypeError`, like `1 + "hello"`.
17:     TypeError,
18: }
19: 
20: impl ResolvedPythonType {
21:     #[must_use]
22:     pub fn union(self, other: Self) -> Self {
23:         match (self, other) {
24:             (Self::TypeError, _) | (_, Self::TypeError) => Self::TypeError,
25:             (Self::Unknown, _) | (_, Self::Unknown) => Self::Unknown,
26:             (Self::Atom(a), Self::Atom(b)) => {
27:                 if a.is_subtype_of(b) {
28:                     Self::Atom(b)
29:                 } else if b.is_subtype_of(a) {
30:                     Self::Atom(a)
31:                 } else {
32:                     Self::Union(FxHashSet::from_iter([a, b]))
33:                 }
34:             }
35:             (Self::Atom(a), Self::Union(mut b)) => {
36:                 // If `a` is a subtype of any of the types in `b`, then `a` is
37:                 // redundant.
38:                 if !b.iter().any(|b_element| a.is_subtype_of(*b_element)) {
39:                     b.insert(a);
40:                 }
41:                 Self::Union(b)
42:             }
43:             (Self::Union(mut a), Self::Atom(b)) => {
44:                 // If `b` is a subtype of any of the types in `a`, then `b` is
45:                 // redundant.
46:                 if !a.iter().any(|a_element| b.is_subtype_of(*a_element)) {
47:                     a.insert(b);
48:                 }
49:                 Self::Union(a)
50:             }
51:             (Self::Union(mut a), Self::Union(b)) => {
52:                 for b_element in b {
53:                     // If `b_element` is a subtype of any of the types in `a`, then
54:                     // `b_element` is redundant.
55:                     if !a
56:                         .iter()
57:                         .any(|a_element| b_element.is_subtype_of(*a_element))
58:                     {
59:                         a.insert(b_element);
60:                     }
61:                 }
62:                 Self::Union(a)
63:             }
64:         }
65:     }
66: }
67: 
68: impl From<&Expr> for ResolvedPythonType {
69:     fn from(expr: &Expr) -> Self {
70:         match expr {
71:             // Primitives.
72:             Expr::Dict(_) => ResolvedPythonType::Atom(PythonType::Dict),
73:             Expr::DictComp(_) => ResolvedPythonType::Atom(PythonType::Dict),
74:             Expr::Set(_) => ResolvedPythonType::Atom(PythonType::Set),
75:             Expr::SetComp(_) => ResolvedPythonType::Atom(PythonType::Set),
76:             Expr::List(_) => ResolvedPythonType::Atom(PythonType::List),
77:             Expr::ListComp(_) => ResolvedPythonType::Atom(PythonType::List),
78:             Expr::Tuple(_) => ResolvedPythonType::Atom(PythonType::Tuple),
79:             Expr::Generator(_) => ResolvedPythonType::Atom(PythonType::Generator),
80:             Expr::FString(_) => ResolvedPythonType::Atom(PythonType::String),
81:             Expr::StringLiteral(_) => ResolvedPythonType::Atom(PythonType::String),
82:             Expr::BytesLiteral(_) => ResolvedPythonType::Atom(PythonType::Bytes),
83:             Expr::NumberLiteral(ast::ExprNumberLiteral { value, .. }) => match value {
84:                 ast::Number::Int(_) => {
85:                     ResolvedPythonType::Atom(PythonType::Number(NumberLike::Integer))
86:                 }
87:                 ast::Number::Float(_) => {
88:                     ResolvedPythonType::Atom(PythonType::Number(NumberLike::Float))
89:                 }
90:                 ast::Number::Complex { .. } => {
91:                     ResolvedPythonType::Atom(PythonType::Number(NumberLike::Complex))
92:                 }
93:             },
94:             Expr::BooleanLiteral(_) => {
95:                 ResolvedPythonType::Atom(PythonType::Number(NumberLike::Bool))
96:             }
97:             Expr::NoneLiteral(_) => ResolvedPythonType::Atom(PythonType::None),
98:             Expr::EllipsisLiteral(_) => ResolvedPythonType::Atom(PythonType::Ellipsis),
99:             // Simple container expressions.
100:             Expr::Named(ast::ExprNamed { value, .. }) => ResolvedPythonType::from(value.as_ref()),
101:             Expr::If(ast::ExprIf { body, orelse, .. }) => {
102:                 let body = ResolvedPythonType::from(body.as_ref());
103:                 let orelse = ResolvedPythonType::from(orelse.as_ref());
104:                 body.union(orelse)
105:             }
106: 
107:             // Boolean operators.
108:             Expr::BoolOp(ast::ExprBoolOp { values, .. }) => values
109:                 .iter()
110:                 .map(ResolvedPythonType::from)
111:                 .reduce(ResolvedPythonType::union)
112:                 .unwrap_or(ResolvedPythonType::Unknown),
113: 
114:             // Unary operators.
115:             Expr::UnaryOp(ast::ExprUnaryOp { operand, op, .. }) => match op {
116:                 UnaryOp::Invert => match ResolvedPythonType::from(operand.as_ref()) {
117:                     ResolvedPythonType::Atom(PythonType::Number(
118:                         NumberLike::Bool | NumberLike::Integer,
119:                     )) => ResolvedPythonType::Atom(PythonType::Number(NumberLike::Integer)),
120:                     ResolvedPythonType::Atom(_) => ResolvedPythonType::TypeError,
121:                     _ => ResolvedPythonType::Unknown,
